narrative_engine.thesis: Volatility is coiled (ATR percentile 1%, EMA spread -2.13 ATR) — the honest play is patience. Do NOT fade the range: compression resolves explosively, and the highest-value action is standing ready with the M1 pullback plan the moment a stack aligns.

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 45/100 — flow fading, whales offering
